title: Changelog - July 2025
content:
## Changelog - July 2025


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105578

New Features:

- Added the ability to clone member accounts from the Search Members page in the Admin.

- Added two new Design Settings to control the display of verified members and their badge in the Recent Featured Members homepage widget: "Only Display 'Verified' Members?" and "Display Verified Badge?"

- Added support for two additional billing cycle options: Biennially (billed every 2 years) and Triennially (billed every 3 years).

- Released the new Admin Universal Search feature. This allows Admins to search by keyword across Member Content, Leads, Form Inquiries, Membership Plans, Widgets, Sidebars, Menus, Forms, and Post Content Settings from a single search field.

- Added Default Schema Markup to the Post Details pages of the Products and Properties Post Types.

Enhancements / Fixes:

- Fixed an issue that prevented the breadcrumbs "position" schema item from displaying the correct value in some cases.

- Updated the display of member profile pages to hide the Overview tab completely when all of the Overview Tab Section Subscription Settings are set to "Hide Section".

- Added the ability to update the member profile URL after changing the Listing Type via bulk actions on the Search Members page in the Admin.

- Added the ability to disable Link Branding for emails from the Domain Manager page in the Admin. This is now disabled by default on all newly launched sites as some users were experiencing issues opening these links in emails.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Manage Posts page in the Admin from working properly in some cases.

- Created a new Email Template variable called last_login_format , which displays the member's last login date formatted based on the Date Format specified in the site's General Settings.

- Fixed a display issue on the Send Newsletter page in the Admin when the newsletter's name to was longer than the provided space.

- Updated the font sizes available in all Froala WYSIWYG dropdowns.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Reviews page related to member profile pages from returning accurate results when the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On was activated.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Sort by Most Views" option from working properly on the Search Members page in the Admin in some cases.

- Updated the Easy-Coupon Codes Add-On logic to display a more accurate text label after applying a coupon code for a one-time payment subscription.

- Updated the display of the Advanced Settings page in the Admin.

- Fixed an issue that was causing Froala fields to include extra HTML tags in email notifications after submitting a form through the Member Dashboard.

- Updated the "Daily Admin Report" sent via the Billing Reminders Email Add-On to only include information for invoices related to the billing cycles selected in the Billing Email Settings .

- Improved the form validation logic for the Verify Business form in the Member Dashboard .

- Fixed an issue when filtering by "Today" using the date filter on the Send Newsletter page in the Admin.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Private member Chat Add-On from working properly in some cases.

- Deprecated the Bootstrap Theme - Module - Member Twitter Feed widget due to Twitter / X not currently supporting the functionality.

- Updated the Schema Markup for Event Posts to use the meta description as a fallback when no post description is available for a post.

- The Business Data import functionality now respects the "Enable Profile Photo Upload" Membership Plan setting when importing members. Member images will no longer be imported if a member is imported into a Membership Plan that does not allow uploading profile images.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Multi-Photo Post Type search results from displaying the correct sort options title after performing a category search in some cases.

- Emails sent using the "Send Test Email" feature on the Send Newsletter page will now be recorded in the Email Outbox.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Order Results By" Post Type Setting from working properly when automatching leads to members when the members are set to display in a Random order.

- Updated internal HTTP requests to specify a custom User-Agent to better identify their source.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the leads logic from matching direct leads with members when submitted on member profile pages in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Affiliate Program Integrations" module from working properly after completing a signup via the "One-Click Google Login" Add-On in some cases.

- Updated the Widget Name validation when saving widgets on the Widget Manager page in the Admin.

- Fixed an issue that affected the ability to use the "Re-Import" feature on the Business Data Page in the Admin in some cases.

- Updated the Multi-Photo Post clone action to also clone the post images, not just the post data, when cloning posts from the Member Dashboard.

- Updated the lead notification emails to use the formatted location address when leads are created via the API.

- Updated the Froala WYSIWYG editors used for editing Email Templates in the Admin to only allow a set of email-safe inline style attributes.

- Updated the "Admin Subscription / Invoice Action" Webhook to include both the previous and new values when triggered.

- Updated the Email Froala WYSIWYG in the Admin to automatically remove all "id" and "class" attributes. Additionally, we removed the image caption feature to further improve compatibility with email clients.

- Fixed an issue where some members were not being returned as search results for all locations that they should in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Compose Email modal in the Admin from selecting an Email Template in some cases.

- Updated the email verification process used to activate new member accounts by clicking on an email verification link to add additional security.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Most Views" sort option from appearing on the Search Members page in the Admin, even when the "Member Profile Analytics" Add-On was enabled.

- Fixed an issue with the UI of saving an SEO Template in the Admin which caused it to appear "stuck".

- Fixed an issue with assigning members to tags via bulk action on the Search Members page in the Admin in some cases.

- Updated Members Webhooks to include the "token" of each member in the data sent to the webhook endpoint.

- Updated the automated 301 redirect creation functionality to only apply for members who have existed for more than 24 hours to prevent excessive 301 redirects from being generated.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Text Direction" Advanced Setting from working properly on the details pages of Multi-Photo Post Types in some cases.

- Added Mongolian as a Default Website Language.

- Updated the Froala Email Editor in the Admin to include Email Variables in the Froala toolbar for easier access.

- Updated the help text description for the "Are these members searchable on the website?" setting on the Membership Plan page in the Admin.

- Fixed an issue that caused the Post Details page to redirect to a 404 error when the Post URL Structure included location information in some cases.

- Created a new text label called "Add Credit Card Popup Subtitle" to display additional text on the Add Credit Card modal. By default, the text label is empty.

- The Google Maps lead form field on the frontend is now compatible with the "Google Map Theme" Design Setting.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the system from including the "alt" attribute for SVG image files on the frontend of sites in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Search Module - Keyword Search widget from working as expected in some cases.

- In all, over 70 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
